# Goal interpretation

When relevant: Use when the instruction contains several requirements, relations or restrictions.

Identify the requested outcome and explicit constraints from the live instruction. Separate visible facts from assumptions. Track unresolved requirements in episode memory. Do not infer extra success rules from a benchmark label.

Use only current official RGB, robot state, the live instruction and this episode's execution feedback. Read the relevant Tool interface before acting. These are possible uses, not mandatory triggers; combine capabilities or decline them when current evidence does not support their use.
